quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for automated synthetic vendor voices calling out food offers in an urban street setting.
quests.explanation: Automated synthetic vendor voices identify a cyber city street food market.
quests.textToSpeak: Street food vendors call out in digitally synthesized voices from their automated stalls.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the very first hesitant bird calls emerging from total forest silence at dawn.
quests.explanation: The first hesitant bird notes of dawn in total silence identify a dense forest at sunrise.
quests.textToSpeak: Dawn mist clings to low branches as the first tentative bird notes break the silence.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the electronic subsidence of radiation alarms as the solar flare ends.
quests.explanation: Radiation alarm subsidence as a solar flare ends identifies a spacecraft in outer space.
quests.textToSpeak: A deep-space nebula glows in pink and gold outside the viewport as a solar flare subsides.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sharp cryogenic gas release hiss in a sterile research environment.
quests.explanation: Cryogenic gas release in a sterile chamber identifies a scientific laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: Liquid nitrogen hisses as the tank releases pressure into the sterile holding chamber.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for effort sounds and instructor encouragement near a muddy outdoor obstacle course.
quests.explanation: Mud and effort sounds near an obstacle course identify a military training base.
quests.textToSpeak: Soldiers train through the mud and sweat of the obstacle course, urged on by instructors.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sustained, very low roar of water movement felt through the vessel.
quests.explanation: A sustained low water-movement roar identifies the deep ocean current system.
quests.textToSpeak: Deep currents move cold water in a sustained roar through the canyon below the submersible.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for an old sputtering generator as the sole light source in a dark stone space.
quests.explanation: A sputtering generator as sole light in a dark stone space identifies an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: A single generator sputters in the darkness, providing just enough power to see by.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sequenced alarm pattern accelerating as an approaching vehicle nears.
quests.explanation: Sequenced docking alarms accelerating with a pod's approach identify an orbital station.
quests.textToSpeak: Docking ring alarms sequence through their pattern as the cargo pod closes the distance.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the near-inaudible breath of meditating people under a large tree in a courtyard.
quests.explanation: Near-inaudible meditative breathing under a courtyard tree identifies an ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: A large banyan tree shades the courtyard; meditating pilgrims breathe almost inaudibly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the soft electronic shuffle and update sound of holographic departure boards.
quests.explanation: Holographic departure board updates identify an airport terminal.
quests.textToSpeak: Holographic flight boards shuffle destinations in a dazzling global display.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for jazz music that pauses precisely when train noise peaks and then resumes.
quests.explanation: Jazz pausing for train noise peaks and resuming identifies a train station concourse.
quests.textToSpeak: A jazz band in the concourse plays between each train, pausing only for the loudest arrivals.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the mechanical hum of microfilm projectors in an otherwise silent archive.
quests.explanation: Microfilm projector hum in silence identifies a public library archive.
quests.textToSpeak: Microfilm readers cast moving shadows on the archive ceiling as they display old footage.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the combined sounds of a food prep area and a retail cosmetics counter.
quests.explanation: Food preparation and cosmetics retail sounds together identify a shopping mall food court.
quests.textToSpeak: Cinnamon roll warmth and perfume from the cosmetics counter greet each new arrival.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the soft resistance and release of a wine cork being carefully removed.
quests.explanation: The careful sound of uncorking wine identifies a luxury restaurant service beginning.
quests.textToSpeak: The sound of a wine cork being eased out is the first sign the evening has truly begun.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the quiet, gentle voice of someone reading memorial names in an outdoor space.
quests.explanation: Reading memorial names quietly in an outdoor setting identifies a city park.
quests.textToSpeak: A bronze plaque on a memorial bench lists names that no longer walk this park.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a repeated soft chime from a patient room in a quiet night ward.
quests.explanation: A patient call bell chiming in a quiet night ward identifies a modern hospital.
quests.textToSpeak: The call bell chimes repeatedly from bed four until the night nurse arrives to answer.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for reversing alarms near the sound of fresh concrete being delivered.
quests.explanation: Backup alarms near fresh concrete delivery identify a construction site.
quests.textToSpeak: Backup alarms beep as concrete trucks reverse among the newly poured foundations.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the overwhelming roar of a combine harvester in a grain field.
quests.explanation: A combine harvester roar in a grain field identifies a lush farm at harvest time.
quests.textToSpeak: The combine moves through the ripe grain, filling the air with a rolling mechanical roar.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for excited surfer calls and the sound of paddling in the surf.
quests.explanation: Excited surfer calls and paddling sounds identify a sandy beach surf break.
quests.textToSpeak: Surfers call out as a perfect set rolls in, each one paddling hard to catch it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the sound of extremely thin, cold air moving across an exposed high-altitude surface.
quests.explanation: Thin frozen-air sound on an exposed ridge identifies a mountain peak.
quests.textToSpeak: Clean pine and frozen air sting the lungs on the high exposed ridge at altitude.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the near-soundless footstep absorption of a mossy forest floor.
quests.explanation: Near-soundless footstep absorption identifies a cedar moss forest floor.
quests.textToSpeak: The deep forest floor is cedar-soft with moss that absorbs nearly every footfall.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a siren pitch-bending as urban geometry distorts its wave path.
quests.explanation: A siren pitch-bending through urban canyons identifies a densely built cyber city.
quests.textToSpeak: A distant siren bends and distorts as it navigates the narrow canyons between towers.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a brief power-system adjustment as solar panels lose their light source.
quests.explanation: Power adjustment during a moon shadow identifies a spacecraft in space.
quests.textToSpeak: A moon's massive shadow sweeps over the spacecraft, cutting off solar power briefly.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a building, room-filling voltage hum reaching a test operational level.
quests.explanation: A room-filling voltage hum reaching test level identifies a physics laboratory.
quests.textToSpeak: The particle accelerator powers up with a rising voltage hum that saturates the room.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the clatter of metal trays in a large institutional dining hall.
quests.explanation: Metal tray clatter in an institutional dining hall identifies a military mess hall.
quests.textToSpeak: Metal trays clatter through the mess hall as the morning shift lines up for breakfast.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for robot joint sounds distorted by operating under enormous water pressure.
quests.explanation: Robot joints whining under extreme pressure identify a deep-ocean expedition.
quests.textToSpeak: Robot joints whine under extreme pressure as the expedition moves across the seafloor.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the faint creak of overloaded old metal shelving in a sealed stone room.
quests.explanation: Old metal shelving creaking in a sealed stone space identifies an underground vault.
quests.textToSpeak: Forgotten treasures rest on metal shelving in the long silence of the sealed vault.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the structural creak and slight gravity sensation of a rotating space station ring.
quests.explanation: Rotation-induced structural creak and walking gravity identify an orbital station.
quests.textToSpeak: The outer ring provides walking gravity as the station rotates through the void.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for the near-silent shuffle of sandalled feet on stone in an arched enclosure.
quests.explanation: Near-silent sandalled movement in arched cloisters identifies an ancient temple.
quests.textToSpeak: Monks file silently through arched cloisters, their sandals barely audible.

quests.instruction: Listen to the description and identify the location.
quests.hint: Listen for a sudden joyful burst of applause in an arrivals transit area.
quests.explanation: Sudden joyful reunion applause at an arrivals gate identifies a busy airport.
quests.textToSpeak: The arrivals gate erupts with applause as long-separated family members are reunited.
